content.what_it_is: Variant of plot_time_series.m for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_frf_abc_data case (Case_15deg_longrun) that plots only 6 selected gauge time series files=[1 4 7 10 12 13] (L7) in a 2x3 grid, with time converted to hours. Per selection (L17-L43): loads ASCII sta_<4-digit fnum> (L21-L26), NaNs zero values via sta(sta(:,2)==0)=NaN (L28), plots sta(:,1)/3600 vs sta(:,2) in subplot(2,3,k) (L30-L31), annotates 'G <k>' at (24.0, 3.0) (L32-L33), sets grid and axis [0 26.6 -2 3.5] (L34-L35), ylabel eta for k=1,4 and xlabel 'time (hr)' for k=4,5,6 (L37-L42). Prints plots_movies/time_ser_less.jpg and .eps (L45-L46).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
sta — station time series array, later reused as label string (L26, L32)

equations.ref: time axis converted from seconds to hours
replacing zero eta values with NaN before plotting

io.name: sta_<fnum> ASCII station time series (via load), 6 files
2x3 grid of eta(t) time series in hours for 6 selected stations

unresolved: Same linear-indexing issue as the sibling script: sta(sta(:,2)==0)=NaN (L28) NaNs positions in column 1 (time) addressed by the column-2 mask, not the eta values themselves.

ylabel condition k==4 (L37) puts the eta label on the first plot of the second row while k==1 covers the first row; label placement for k=4 overlaps the xlabel condition (L40) — appears intended for a 2x3 grid but slightly inconsistent (row 2 starts at k=4).
Selection [1 4 7 10 12 13] with labels G1..G6 (L7, L32) matches the file_sta selection in plot_bathy_stations_less.m; the mapping to physical FRF gauges is not documented here.
Axis time limit 26.6 hr (L35) implies roughly 95,760 s of simulation; the actual run length is not verifiable from this file.
